name: Ripio wPEN
oneLiner: WPEN is Ripio's Peruvian-sol wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Each wPEN is backed 1:1 by liquid instruments denominated in Peruvian sol (PEN) held in Peruvian bank accounts, with reserves periodically attested by local public accountants per Ripio's wFIAT framework
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 PEN stablecoin under Ripio's wFIAT framework: a Ripio subsidiary mints and burns supply via role-based access control (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE / MINTER_ROLE) against PEN collateral, with mint and redeem routed through Ripio's PEN on/off-ramp; the contract is a UUPS-upgradeable, pausable ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit

sources.label: Ethereum PublicNode RPC (fresh hasRole/paused/implementation-slot reads at block 25648202)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-07-30. Fresh re-derivation across two independent surfaces: the verified LatamStable implementation source (Blockscout) is a plain OpenZeppelin v5 ERC-20 with Burnable, Pausable, AccessControl, Permit, and UUPS modules and exposes no per-address blacklist or freeze function; the only transfer-stop surface is the global pause() gated by PAUSER_ROLE. On-chain reads on Ethereum at block 25648202 confirmed paused() = false, the EIP-1967 implementation slot unchanged at 0x9d6266a9167f17ff3dd20f63a474812d0cd47969, and PAUSER_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by the Ripio EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b, with the 4-of-7 Ripio Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. All six tracked deployments (Ethereum, Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis) are EIP-1167 clones of this same implementation. A live issuer-controlled global pause exists and the UUPS upgrade path could add a holder-selective freeze later, so possible is retained; no current per-holder blacklist or freeze function exists in the deployed code.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ripio issues wPEN natively on Ethereum, Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis: every deployment is an EIP-1167 clone of one Ripio master implementation, and per-chain MINTER_ROLE is held only by Ripio-administered accounts. No third-party bridge carries the representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: PEN is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WPEN is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WPEN during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
